annotations.title: vvith me.
annotations.text: [1] God vſeth not man as a brute beaſt or a blocke: but ſo vvorketh in him and by him that free-wil may concurre in euery action vvith his grace, vvhich is always the principal. The heretics to auoid this concurrence in working & labouring, tranſlate [2], which is vvith me: where the Apoſtle rather ſaith, which laboureth with me.

annotations.title: Let vs eate and drinke.
annotations.text: ◦ S. Ambroſe applieth theſe vvordes to our Chriſtian Epicurians that taks avvay faſting, and deny the merite thereof: Hovv can vve be ſaued (ſaith he) if we vvaſh not avvay our ſinnes by faſting, ſeeing the ſcriptures ſay, faſting and almes deliuer from ſinne? Vvhat are theſe nevv maiſters then that exclude al merite of faſting? is not this the very voice of the heathen ſaying, Let vs eate and drinke, to morovv vve ſhal die? li. 10. epiſt. ep. 82.
